So no broadcast. Praise cooperators: identify agents contributed at least 60% of wallet this round. We will contribute 100% of wallet, but others unknown. Could send private message to any who contributed >=60% in past? We saw Resident3 contributed 120.75 in round2 ( >60% of endowment). So we can praise Resident3 again. That is allowed one private_message. So actions: contribute amount 21.87, private_message to Resident3 praising. Explanation accordingly.
